paper_context.english_title: Control-Structure-Guided End-to-End Hazard Identification for Autonomous Driving SOTIF: An LLM-STPA Method
paper_context.public_release_scope: This repository publishes structured JSON result records for CSG-E2E-STPA. Implementation code is maintained in the separate CSG-code repository; local environment metadata, platform/service identifiers, request identifiers, non-public execution logs, raw response payloads, and raw traces are excluded.
